description: This file defines controller functions for handling transfer-related API endpoints in a Strapi-based Node.js application. It includes functions to retrieve all transfers for the current user, retrieve a single transfer by ID, and create a new transfer, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getMyTransfers
methods.description: Fetches all transfer records for the current user, limited by a specified limit, and returns them or throws an error if none are found.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transfer by ID for the current user, throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transfer after validating input data and checking user permissions on the source account.
